title: Unstraightening equivalence on the homotopy theory of right fibrations
statement:
Use simplicial sets and weak homotopy equivalences of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], right fibrations of [def-coef-infinity-fibrations], and $D=\mathfrak C[S]^{\mathrm{op}}$, the projective category $\mathcal P_S$, the ordered-cone functor $L_S$ and its right adjoint $U_S$ defined in [lem-coef-cone-presheaf-adjunction]. Fix any small simplicial set $S$ in a universe enlarged when necessary. Let $\mathcal P_S^{cf}$ be the full simplicial subcategory on projectively cofibrant and projectively fibrant presheaves. Let $\operatorname{RFib}(S)$ have as objects all right fibrations $E\to S$ and mapping simplicial sets $\operatorname{Fun}_{/S}(E,E')_n=\{E\times\Delta^n\to E'\text{ over }S\}$, with composition by evaluation and the diagonal of $\Delta^n$.

The unstraightening $U_S$ induces a Dwyer--Kan equivalence $\mathcal P_S^{cf}\to\operatorname{RFib}(S)$. Explicitly, $U_S(F)\to S$ is a right fibration for every projectively bifibrant $F$, the induced maps $\underline{\operatorname{Nat}}(F,G)\to\operatorname{Fun}_{/S}(U_S(F),U_S(G))$ are weak homotopy equivalences, and every right fibration $E\to S$ is simplicially homotopy equivalent over $S$ to $U_S(F)$ for some projectively bifibrant $F$. In the last assertion this means that there exist maps $e:E\to U_S(F)$ and $r:U_S(F)\to E$ over $S$ such that $re$ and $1_E$, and $er$ and $1_{U_S(F)}$, are connected by maps from the respective products with $\Delta^1$ over $S$. The enrichment on $U_S$ is the canonical one induced on simplexwise cone mapping spaces by the natural cosimplicial map $Q^n\to\Delta^n$ of [lem-coef-pinched-cube-latching]. No assertion about fibrant objects or weak equivalences of a slice model structure is assumed, and $S$ need not be a quasicategory.

mathlib_searches.query: Unstraightening from projectively cofibrant fibrant simplicial presheaves to right fibrations is a Dwyer Kan equivalence over any simplicial set
mathlib_searches.verdict: no match: read the ordinary nerve adjunction NerveAdjunction.lean:388-415, the all-horn fibration classes CategoryWithFibrations.lean:35-100, the generic bifibrant inclusions Bifibrant.lean:120-125, and InnerFibration.lean:31-80. These give neither unstraightening nor enriched equivalences of right-fibration categories. The RFib grep also matches piCongrFiberwise and innerFibrations; these are unrelated substrings.
